provenance: AI-authored controlled synthetic documents and questions; not production traffic or an external benchmark
annotation_validation: Each evidence excerpt checked against the current document version's PostgreSQL chunks at the labelled page; not a complete independent human relevance review
overlap: Different questions share the same four documents and twelve pages; the split is question-level, not document-level
limitations: Only four controlled documents, not a large representative production corpus
One labelled supporting page per case; other partially relevant pages may exist
No unanswerable questions, answer-quality scoring, security test scoring, or generation accuracy measurement
Do not tune on the fixed test questions after viewing their results and still describe them as untouched holdout data
No retrieval results or improvement percentages have been measured by this generation script
